description.value: Clyde's Pub is a casual neighbourhood pub in Grand Forks, BC, serving American-style food and drinks with entertainment options including two coin-operated pool tables, a 10-foot projection screen, and five flat-screen TVs. The venue offers both dine-in and takeout meals and features a patio deck for outdoor dining and a horseshoe bar for gathering with friends. It is a well-rounded social stop for cyclists passing through the Boundary Country region.
